result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot** as the best all-round CRM.

However, the best choice depends on whether you're primarily managing sales leads, customer relationships, marketing, or ongoing client accounts.

Here are the five I'd shortlist in 2026.

## Best CRMs for small teams

![21 Best CRM Enterprise Software Reviewed For 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/E3oBllJko6DSkC1G-YxonkpSd-C9EJzphRnffFc13dKq176hHlHIBef_KD3uo3Rj4h1fcldcCQ6woqfNfkWWmNW8Rs1_qiHKjMrnT7yrtNAkkpWII-RvqcBN_-0EERClJKgsbj3AQum9lvjpnXVV_ofvoY4dYvM4uvHF3Aza7RJS9SAW_-O73lSaxuQ1_7Sl?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot CRM**

(Best overall)

- Excellent contact and deal management
- Email tracking, tasks and sales pipelines
- Free plan for up to 2 users
- Easy to get started

Best if you want one system that can grow with your business.

[HubSpot website](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![Pipedrive Culture | Comparably](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LL0qs5ZEn5bajHXZMpCmlJ4Q8G8bG-uCRPdMDaugOTZ5M83xr5SdfSJtpaTsU9pV5XZU_j6tdK98aLeb5eQtmf3jAulEyqWXtwu_NCqqantmt4RgTKgW92e5jqAqiwI5Gvz6HoJSFRLf0DV2WCKF0F5we1qdhyYgERFOvFPWSwO__wWT47lukE3R9cSOeuBr?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Excellent visual sales pipeline
- Easy deal tracking
- Follow-up reminders
- Straightforward interface

Best if your team actively manages sales opportunities.

[Pipedrive website](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![TheProwess | Zoho CRM'de Yeni Dönem: Eski Arayüz 15 Temmuz'da Tamamen Kaldırılıyor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mhOzD_IXTeMyjegHs7_31H-nZlvGoIQWY2PfiTmHpwuQOA09A9NutmTAM8TWT2HF-7JryptkgV-lS_xHcaI7d43ujbBUTvqfxj-z3nk-gdRQr3-Ei-qigHIPik-T14ytWC4EuYLl0he93dU9qCw5sHTS1LPdprZuUjTWv0UHX5wzcmxSTdtKBrPPwq-xdGBE?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

(Best value)

- Strong automation
- Highly customisable
- Free for up to 3 users
- Large ecosystem of business tools

Best if you want flexibility without a big software budget.

[Zoho CRM website](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Descargar Freshsales CRM varies-with-device para Web Apps - Filehippo.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ymGWkXtkAC7MoWysGML3OKgHF9O0MPKH1PfAAeDjk1aaZrRWaVBb9r5y-Kf_8j4xYqKU0KB7QvzLaYT0HE0Vv7VVhtrsyXiqQzkmNrQWCEXFxliHIByLJsgnf2ztG74VQ6KpL_qyhXQE--CUkaD3WIbFGDInuBn5hMKNEjmTwahJ5xR1Qf4y9c43huoiOovk?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- Built-in phone and communication tools
- Sales automation
- Lead scoring
- Competitive entry pricing

Best if your team spends a lot of time calling and following up with prospects.

[Freshsales website](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![monday.com Products](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/rL9Bzm932Es-G8eSD-IugxH25VpIFj2GrnbBExwUqA2Nr3S2F-13Q2QUuWHSsw5hSYAN9ENyOY_MTevU9OZtOiwp-cUhvAnLAqY_40r6pFQsW3KxPgFxL3JCosxfn4L6Jfwp2NCZNME-i2pDOLdg2P_TmFE26A6QIif7ztMuqYUxcMfuJMeKmmPBjbxzqwot?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. monday CRM**

- Highly visual interface
- Customer and project workflows
- Team collaboration
- Customisable dashboards

Best if you want sales, tasks and team workflows in one place.

[monday CRM website](https://monday.com/crm)

## Quick comparison

| CRM | Best for | Starting point |
|--------|--------|--------|
| HubSpot | All-round CRM | Free |
| Pipedrive | Sales pipeline | A\$19/user/mo |
| Zoho CRM | Value and flexibility | Free / A\$22 |
| Freshsales | Sales and calling | A\$15/user/mo |
| monday CRM | Workflows and collaboration | A\$19/seat/mo |


*Indicative Australian pricing, generally based on annual billing. Check tax, seat minimums and plan limits before purchasing.* [merchantcompare.com.au](https://merchantcompare.com.au/crm-software/for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[australiansmallbusiness.com.au](https://australiansmallbusiness.com.au/software/best-crm-for-small-business-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

- **1–2 people\:** HubSpot.
- **3–5 people\:** HubSpot or Zoho.
- **5–15 people\:** Pipedrive or HubSpot.
- **Sales-heavy business\:** Pipedrive.
- **Lots of custom processes\:** Zoho.

## Let me narrow it down for your business

There are a few things that would change my recommendation.

**What type of business are you running, and what do you primarily want the CRM to do?**

For example, are you looking to\:

- Manage leads and sales opportunities?
- Keep track of existing clients and relationships?
- Manage email marketing and campaigns?
- Track enquiries, proposals and follow-ups?
- Manage projects and client communications?

If you tell me your team size and what you need it to do, I can narrow this down to the **best 2 options**, including pricing and which one I'd actually choose.

search_results.description: TechRadar’s 2026 guide reviews CRM platforms for small businesses, emphasizing that modern systems combine contact and pipeline management with AI, lead generation, automation, billing, and post-sale operations. Salesforce is the overall recommendation, offering scalable sales, service, marketing, Slack integration, and autonomous Agentforce workflows; its Starter plan begins at $25 per user monthly, while advanced automation requires the $100 Pro plan. Freshsales is highlighted for value, with affordable plans, Freddy AI, sentiment analysis, email synchronization, and new lead-capture tools. Zoho CRM is the easiest to adopt, combining intuitive workflows, lead generation, reporting, and integration with the wider Zoho ecosystem. Other recommendations include HubSpot for its capable free plan, Monday Sales CRM for sales teams, Streak for Gmail users, Pipedrive for user experience, Insightly for project management, and Workbooks for reporting and financial tracking. The guide advises comparing usability, scalability, integrations, automation, support, and total AI costs, since providers use different billing models. Effective adoption also requires clear objectives, training, ongoing support, and employee feedback.
